title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Though your text makes me uneasy lol
Thanks, no no no I just didn’t want to text him congrats if there was some question or he hadn’t been told yet
Yeah I'm assuming he has...got it from agent

We pal’ed around in Lakeland a few years ago when he had one of the worst years of his career. He had just gotten in to archery and we shot bows together like every day. I have a soft spot for that dude. Really exceptional human being. Stoked for him
I'm gonna give you a ring next week and pick your brain about Mize...I gotta go down to Auburn on the 17th to do a profile on him
👍🏻 good deal holler at me. I was with the whole squad last week at UF. Was a great night to watch some pitching. I think you’ll enjoy seeing him in the college atmosphere
